home.about.title: A data scientist who
home.about.lead: Five years of turning ambiguous business questions into measurable systems.
home.about.body:
I work where statistics meets software. Most of my time goes into the unglamorous middle: cleaning the data nobody documented, choosing a metric that matches the actual decision, and building the evaluation harness before the model.

The rest goes into communication. A model that nobody trusts is a model that does not ship, so I spend real effort on charts, notebooks and short written briefs that make results legible to engineers, analysts and executives alike.
